title: sse: fix streaming chunking/framing for partial JSON and delimiter ordering
author: Anika Rao
description: Fixes a class of SSE streaming bugs where partial JSON tokens could be emitted with incorrect delimiter/event ordering under high-concurrency and batching, causing downstream OpenAI-compatibility consumers and structured-output validators to see malformed partial objects. Root cause: the streaming framer and parser had two ordering assumptions that could be violated when continuous batching and prefix/KV cache replay interleaved token boundaries; specifically the delimiter ("\n\n") handling and partial-json boundary coalescing were performed in the wrong component and lost ordering guarantees across async writes. This PR moves delimiter handling into the framer, introduces an explicit partial-json state machine to emit well-formed chunk boundaries, adds strict ordering tests, and aligns the JS OpenAI-compat layer to expect the corrected framing. Changes are backward-compatible for most clients; we add a compatibility note and a short rollout plan that ramps the change behind a feature flag for 48 hours before full traffic. Testing: unit tests for framer and parser, stress e2e harness with high-concurrency SSE clients, and CI integration tests for openai-compat streaming. Checklist: reproduce issue locally, add unit tests, add e2e stress test, update docs, add rollout/feature-flag, notify SDK teams. Related: ENG-2713, ENG-2750.
